title: Store and display VirtualWorld calendar dates on Memory records across Viwo and Commons

sections.what: Reuse VirtualWorld's existing calendar (game_year, game_month, game_day, calendar_config, get_current_time) to stamp an explicit ISO world_datetime field on Memory records alongside tick, and format real calendar dates + relative ages in Mind View, timelines, and agent recall.
sections.why: VirtualWorld already tracks calendar dates (e.g. Oct 14, 2016 in Millwood via world.game_day/game_month/game_year and World Sky Time & Date), while Memory records currently only store integer tick. Storing world_datetime from the existing calendar gives multi-day timelines, Mind View, and standalone Commons chats real calendar dates without inventing a second clock source.
sections.how:
1. Add a shared helper that reads VirtualWorld's existing calendar (game_year, game_month, game_day, get_current_time / total_game_minutes) to produce an ISO world_datetime string (e.g. 2016-10-14T08:01:00).
2. Stamp world_datetime on Memory creation paths (engine/player.py, engine/memory_dynamics.py, routes/memory.py) and derive it when reading older tick-only memories.
3. Update Mind View / memory timeline formatting and prompt recall helpers to display calendar dates and relative age (e.g. Oct 14, 2016 08:01 - 2h ago) cleanly.
4. Add pytest and JS unit tests covering dated memory creation, serialization, and timeline formatting.
sections.verify: Run pytest on memory/calendar tests and JS unit tests for mind-view/memory-context confirming world_datetime round-trip using VirtualWorld's existing calendar.

acceptance.text: Memory creation and serialization preserve an explicit ISO world_datetime field derived from VirtualWorld's existing calendar (game_year/game_month/game_day + clock time) alongside tick.
No duplicate start_date field is added; VirtualWorld's existing calendar_config / set_game_date remains the single source of truth.
Mind View, memory timelines, and agent recall format real calendar dates and relative ages instead of bare tick or Day N counters.

sections.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Mind View memory timeline (reading the date set in World Sky Time & Date).

Manual verification steps:
1. Set date in World Sky (e.g. 14/10/2016) and create a memory.
2. Open Character Inspector -> Mind -> Memories.
   - expected: Memory displays Oct 14, 2016 and time/relative age.
